The MECCA View

Inspired by the gardens of Harlem, this fragrance invites you to wrap yourself in notes of Angelica seeds, saffron, damascene roses, violet, ebon wood and leather. Dip into this heady concoction when you’re in need of a scent that makes a statement.

  • Product details

    Fragrance notes

    Angelica seeds, saffron, violet, damascena rose, ebony wood, wild leather.

    Usage

    Spray liberally on pulse points.

    Item Code

    V-814772

  • Ingredients

    Alcohol denat, parfum (fragrance),aqua (water),alpha-isomethyl ionone, amyl cinnamal, benzyl salicylate, citral, citronellol, coumarin, eugenol, geraniol, hydroxycitronellal, limonene, linalool., , Occasionally, our brands refresh their products and the ingredients they use may change slightly. We aim to update our digital platforms with any changes as soon as we can, but you’re best to check the product packaging for the most up-to-date ingredient list. If you want to double check an ingredient, please contact our customer care team.

Free shipping & returns

Shipping fees & delivery

Premium shipping: FREE on orders $25 and over.

Read more about our shipping options here.

Returns & refunds

If you change your mind about your purchase, you can return the product for free with a proof of purchase and receive one of the following:

Refund: If returned within 90 days of purchase and in new, unused and resaleable condition.

Exchange/store credit: If returned within 90 days of purchase and is unwrapped, opened and lightly sampled.

Read more about our returns here.

Click & Collect

Click & Collect

Need your beauty fix? We’re making it easy. Order online and pick up at your preferred MECCA store. Please note, some of our products are not available for Click & Collect and all items in your bag will need to be available in order to use this service. Learn more about Click & Collect.


Store availability


Click & Collect is available across all MECCA stores in New Zealand (excluding Mecca Cosmetica Ballantynes).
